site.description.message: DataQL provides data queries, transformations, and script extensions. Dataway embeds API editing, debugging, publishing, and OpenAPI documents into Hasor, Solon, and Spring applications.

homepage.hero.description.message: Dataway embeds API editing, debugging, and publishing into your Java application. DataQL expresses data queries, transformations, and aggregation in scripts.

homepage.hero.note.message: Embedded in your app · Visual development · Open source

homepage.hero.guide.message: See the complete setup and publishing steps for this SQL API

homepage.console.title.message: An end-to-end workspace for your APIs.

homepage.console.description.message: Write a script, supply parameters, inspect the result, and publish an API. Draft changes take effect when you publish again.

homepage.console.edit.message: Edit DataQL or SQL, pass request parameters, and inspect the result.

homepage.console.result.message: Choose a result handler. Preview JSON, text, tables, and images, or download files.

homepage.console.publish.message: Browse and call published APIs. Open the editor to manage drafts and release history.

homepage.language.title.message: Data in the shape you need.

homepage.language.description.message: Compose data with expressions, functions, and transformations. Develop APIs in Dataway or run the engine independently in Java.

homepage.query.transform.message: Select fields and compute new values in a single transformation.

homepage.query.group.message: Import a built-in function to group records by a field.

homepage.query.sql.message: Query a database with the SQL executor. This example uses ds1 from the example application.

homepage.feature.sources.description.message: Access databases by name, compose queries in scripts, and integrate application transactions.

homepage.feature.auth.description.message: Read identities from your login system and control access to APIs and console operations.

homepage.feature.docs.description.message: Generate OpenAPI and Swagger documents for published APIs. Browse and call them with Swagger UI.

homepage.feature.results.description.message: Return JSON, text, CSV, images, or binary files. Add your own result handlers for other formats.

homepage.application.description.message: Add an integration module to embed API development in Spring, Solon, or Hasor, using your existing data sources and services.

homepage.start.description.message: Publish a SQL API with the Spring example, or begin with a DataQL script.

homepage.description.message: Edit, debug, and publish APIs in Java with Dataway. Query, transform, and combine data with DataQL. Integrates with Spring, Solon, Hasor, multiple data sources, and OpenAPI.
